chars.S: SAFOUANE: a young Moroccan worker wearing a mustard-yellow work hoodie dusty with aluminium shavings, dark navy work trousers and black work boots.
chars.N: NOUR: the boss's young daughter wearing a long light-blue denim dress with a white cardigan and a small pink shoulder bag.
chars.B: THE BOSS: a heavy Moroccan man in his fifties with a thick grey moustache, wearing a brown leather jacket over a red checked shirt and grey trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: On a sunny street in Mohammedia, SAFOUANE and NOUR stand close together laughing in front of a bakery, she holds a long baguette. Just behind them THE BOSS leans out of the window of an old white car, staring at them with a furious shocked face. Comic awkward moment.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small aluminium workshop full of window frames and a cutting machine, THE BOSS points angrily toward the door, ordering SAFOUANE who stands hunched and obedient holding a small paper bag.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE walking on a Moroccan neighbourhood sidewalk stops in surprise as NOUR comes out of a bakery door carrying warm bread in her hands, both look at each other surprised.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NOUR walks up to SAFOUANE with a confident friendly smile while he stands stiff and nervous, looking at the ground, on a busy Mohammedia street with shops.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE looking at NOUR completely charmed with a dreamy happy face, NOUR smiling and talking to him, small hearts-like sparkle of happiness, sunny street in front of the bakery.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE and NOUR laughing loudly together on the sidewalk, he holds his belly laughing, she covers her mouth laughing, warm afternoon light, Moroccan street.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: THE BOSS drives slowly past in an old white car, his head turned toward the sidewalk, staring coldly at SAFOUANE and NOUR. SAFOUANE freezes in panic while NOUR looks surprised.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE walking alone down a Moroccan street toward the workshop, sweating nervously, forcing a fake calm smile, holding the small paper bag.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SAFOUANE stepping through the door of the aluminium workshop, and THE BOSS stands waiting inside with arms crossed and a dark threatening face, tense standoff.
